title: Jude and the Ledger
author: Xanthe Thornbury
blurb: Quentin Okonkwo, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
